Loco Restaurant
Dear Cruiser, thank you for such a detailed and cheerful review! 😄

"Not exactly close to Han Market, but delicious" – thank you for coming to find us even though we're a bit away from Han Market!

You enjoyed the three regional specialties (pork belly with shrimp paste sauce, scallops, and spear squid) and with 4 Tiger beers, it came to just under 1.2 million VND – we're glad the value satisfied you! Sorry the Tiger ran out midway and you had to switch to Larue ㅠㅠ We'll stock up better next time 😆

"The food doesn't come out super fast, but it arrived around the time we weren't exhausted yet, and overall it was delicious" – this description is so precise and honest that we're actually grateful. We'll work on improving our serving speed a little more.

"You can order even if you can't speak Vietnamese or English well lol" – this made us laugh! 😂 Being able to communicate with gestures is part of the fun of traveling.

Please visit us again on your next trip to Da Nang. You didn't rate the spear squid since it's a personal preference – but do try other dishes next time too!

Thank you.
